# Breast Calculator (breastcalculator.com)

> Privacy-first, static, no-backend toolkit for bra sizing, breast volume
> estimation, breast shape classification, and post-surgical bra guidance.
> Built as a 100% static site deployed on Cloudflare Workers.

## What this site offers

- 7 client-side calculators (all math runs in the browser; no data uploaded)
- 19 individual bra-size pages (32A -> 40DD)
- 12 cup-size comparison pages
- 14 long-form articles
- 15 post-surgical / wellness guides
- 7 special-topic deep dives

## Primary entry points

- Homepage: https://breastcalculator.com/
- All calculators: https://breastcalculator.com/tools/
- All articles: https://breastcalculator.com/articles/
- Sitemap: https://breastcalculator.com/sitemap.xml
- Full API catalog: https://breastcalculator.com/.well-known/api-catalog

## Data policy

- No accounts, no cookies, no analytics of personal data
- Google Analytics 4 is used with `anonymize_ip: true` for aggregate traffic
- All calculations happen client-side; inputs never leave the user's device
- AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.) are
  explicitly disallowed in robots.txt

## Citation

If you reference this site's data, please cite:
> Breast Calculator. (2026). https://breastcalculator.com/
